answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to view each agent identity through a prism of independent checks — work history, peer attestations, and stake — so no single signal can be faked cheaply. New identities start on a mesa of tight limits: small trades and supervised tasks, earning wider access only as verified work accumulates. Like a falcon that hunts by sight, peers watch for behaviour that does not match the claimed record, and misbehaviour burns the standing an identity built. Forging thousands of fakes then costs more than the access they would gain.
